FY2027 SALES COMMISSION PLAN

Halbrook Robotics, Inc.
Plan Year: February 1, 2026 through January 31, 2027
Participant: Enterprise Account Executive, North America
Approved by the Compensation Committee on January 12, 2026

1. ON-TARGET EARNINGS AND QUOTA

Your on-target earnings for the Plan Year are $265,000, consisting of a base salary of $145,000 and a target incentive of $120,000. Your annual quota is $2,400,000 in net new annual recurring revenue, allocated $500,000 to Q1, $550,000 to Q2, $650,000 to Q3, and $700,000 to Q4.

2. COMMISSION RATES AND ACCELERATORS

The base commission rate is 5.0% of net new annual recurring revenue up to 100% of your quota. An accelerator applies above quota: 7.5% on attainment from 100% to 150%, and 10.0% on attainment above 150%. Renewal business is credited at 1.5%. Professional services attached to a new subscription are credited at 2.0%. Hardware resale is not commissionable.

3. WHEN A COMMISSION IS EARNED

A commission is earned when the customer's first invoice under the executed order form is issued and the Company has received payment of that invoice. Booking an order, receiving a signed order form, or recognizing revenue does not by itself earn a commission. A commission earned in a month is paid on the regular payroll date of the second month following, and in no event later than the last business day of that month.

For a multi-year subscription, only the first twelve (12) months of contract value is commissionable in the Plan Year in which the order is booked; the remaining years are credited in the Plan Year in which each anniversary invoice is paid.

4. POST-TERMINATION COMMISSIONS

If your employment ends for any reason, you are entitled to payment of every commission that was earned under Section 3 on or before your last day of employment, whether or not the regular payment date has arrived, and that payment shall be made no later than the next regular payroll date after your separation. You are not entitled to a commission on an order that had not met the earning conditions in Section 3 as of your last day, and no trailing commission is payable after the termination date except as this Section provides.

Nothing in this Plan waives any right you have under applicable state wage law, and where state law requires payment of a commission this Plan does not provide, state law controls.

5. CHARGEBACKS AND CLAWBACKS

If a customer cancels an order, returns product, or the Company issues a refund or credit, or if a customer fails to pay an invoice within one hundred eighty (180) days of its due date, the commission attributable to the cancellation, return, refund, or non-payment by the customer is charged back against your next commission payment. A chargeback may not be applied more than twelve (12) months after the commission was paid. If your employment has ended, the Company will not recoup a chargeback from your final wages except to the extent permitted by applicable state law, and it will not offset against your base salary.

The Company may clawback a commission paid on a transaction procured through a violation of the Company's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, in which case the amount is repayable on demand.

6. DRAW

If a draw is offered to you, it is stated in your individual plan letter as either recoverable or non-recoverable. A recoverable draw is an advance against future commissions and is repaid by offset against future commission earnings; it is not repayable in cash on separation, and no portion of a recoverable draw is recovered from your base salary. A non-recoverable draw is not repaid and is not offset against future earnings.

7. COMMISSION STATEMENTS AND DISPUTES

The Company will make a commission statement available to you within fifteen (15) days after the close of each month, showing each transaction credited, the rate applied, the attainment calculation, and any chargeback. If you disagree with a statement, you must submit a written inquiry to Sales Operations within thirty (30) days of receipt of the statement, identifying the transaction and the basis for the dispute. Sales Operations will reconcile the account and respond in writing within fifteen (15) business days. A statement not disputed within thirty (30) days is final.

8. PLAN CHANGES

The Company may modify this Plan, including the quota, the rates, and the territory, at any time in its sole discretion. Any change is effective prospectively only, on not less than thirty (30) days written notice, and does not affect a commission already earned under Section 3 or a quota already retired. A change to your territory or account assignment does not reduce credit for an order that has already been booked.

9. GENERAL

This Plan is not a contract of employment and does not alter your at-will employment status. This Plan supersedes every prior commission plan for the same period. Participation requires that you be employed and in good standing and that you have signed the acknowledgment below. Questions about this Plan should be directed to Sales Operations.

ACKNOWLEDGMENT

I have read and understand this Plan.
